		foundLoanRequest: LoanRequest = LoanRequest.allInstance()->any(o|o.RequestID = requestid)
	precondition:
		requestid.oclIsTypeOf(Integer) and
		loanamount.oclIsTypeOf(Real)
	postcondition:
		let newLoan: LoanRequest in

		newLoan.Email = email and
		newLoan.WorkReferences = workreferences and
		newLoan.CreditReferences = creditreferences and
		newLoan.CheckingAccountNumber = checkingaccountnumber and
		newLoan.SecurityNumber = securitynumber and
		LoanRequest.allInstance()->includes(newLoan) and
		self.CurrentLoanRequest = newLoan and
		result = true 
		else self.CurrentLoanRequest = foundLoanRequest and
		result = true 
		endif 
}
